reference: owner-supplied Cisco Secure Endpoint Device Trajectory screenshots
subject: /xdr/edr/device-trajectory (AMP renderer) vs the Cisco reference, and vs /xdr/endpoints/:device/trajectory
method: runtime DOM assertions + live projection probe. Classifications: CISCO_BASELINE_GAP · NIVXFORGE_VALID_EXTENSION · DATASET_DIFFERENCE · NOT_OBSERVED · NOT_PROVEN

main_trajectory_graph.evidence: Rows are per-process-instance lanes with elbow parent->child connectors carrying data-parent-lane-index from authoritative parent_iid (375 resolved edges). The plot is a relationship graph, not independent rows. It READS flatter than Cisco because 446 of 446 process lanes are END_NOT_OBSERVED (no process_exit is collected), so each lifeline is a short solid segment plus a long dashed open tail.

solid_vs_dotted_lifelines.evidence: lane_end_state = {END_NOT_OBSERVED: 446, NOT_APPLICABLE: 45}. Solid means observed lifetime; dashed means the exit was never reported. Making these solid would assert a lifetime the sensor never observed.

system_vs_files_and_network.evidence: Both sections render bracketed ([ System ], [ Files & Network ]) with a boundary rule; group_counts PROCESS 446 / FILE 3 / NETWORK 41 / OTHER 1; at rows 453-488 the section label and 35 NETWORK/FILE lanes render with real peers.

semantic_event_glyphs.evidence: Glyph shape is selected from the real event_type (13 shapes; now also exposed as data-glyph). This endpoint's vocabulary is network_connect 3731, process_create 262, detection 4, file_write 3 — so the System section is legitimately one shape and the Files & Network section is circle-based network marks. No glyph is manufactured for a row with no event.

inactive_time_region_24h_scrubber.evidence: amp-nav-hatch-before/after use url(#amp-nav-hatch) diagonal hatch for time outside the selected window; widths recompute on handle drag.

inactive_time_region_main_canvas.evidence_after: amp-canvas-hatch-after present with url(#amp-canvas-hatch) and label 'no sensor coverage'; on the default 24h window x=949.8 w=349.2 for observed_end 15:46Z
inactive_time_region_main_canvas.semantic_note: The AMP plot area IS the selected window, so 'outside the window' cannot exist inside it. The hatch therefore states the honest thing it can state: the part of the window that lies outside the endpoint's OBSERVED EVIDENCE RANGE. 'No visibility' and 'nothing happened' are different claims.

event_timestamp_projection.evidence_before: selection drew a glyph ring + row tint only; no temporal guide
event_timestamp_projection.evidence_after: amp-temporal-guide renders a dashed vertical guide plus an hh:mm:ss chip on the axis, data-at = the selected observation's exact timestamp (verified 2026-09-06T06:01:51.930000+00:00)

activity_default_state.evidence: Fresh load: amp-activity-panel 1, amp-details-panel 0. Clicking a row opens Activity Details; the back arrow restores the list and amp-workspace data-row-start is unchanged. No modal, no redirect. The owner's screenshot showed Details because a row had already been selected.

activity_row_structure.evidence: Row cells are [actor/hash] [glyph] [target] [timestamp] — e.g. 'bash · root | glyph | bash | 06:01:51' and 'proc_c0a62530782c | glyph | bash | 14:10:14'. The NivXForge quick-filter tabs are absent from the baseline presentation.

header.evidence: Hostname · in group ◇ not collected · N compromise events · Show details (drawer) · Actions (menu with disabled reasons). Isolation state and the epistemic chip live in the drawer, not the strip.

navigator.evidence: 30-day density curve over real per-day counts with per-day cells carrying data-observations/data-compromise; red strips only where malicious+detections > 0; 24-hour band with real 6-minute bins, hatch, temporal cursor, draggable band and handles, day transition. Nothing is hardcoded to resemble Cisco.

navigation_mechanics.evidence: wheel -> rows, Shift+wheel -> time, Ctrl/Cmd+wheel -> zoom, window.scrollY stays 0, drag pans both axes, deep links ?device=&at=&event= select and centre. Re-verified in iteration_102.

nivxforge_extensions_kept: evidence provenance per observation (raw_event_id, canonical_event_id, evidence_id, adapter, origin)
explicit MITRE non-attribution statement in Activity Details
endpoint Actions menu with honest disabled reasons
explicitly_not_done: no legacy Device Trajectory header controls in AMP (owner instruction 2026-09-07)
no NivXRay intelligence overlays inside the trajectory
no second telemetry / evidence / trajectory / detection store
no inferred lineage (no PID-only, name, proximity or row-order inference)

screenshot_states_verified.artefact_note: Runtime screenshots are captured by the browser automation host and stored under /root/.emergent/automation_output/<run>/ — they are not written into /app.

CISCO_VISUAL_CONFORMANCE: PASS for every renderer-controlled item; residual differences from the Cisco screenshots are DATASET_DIFFERENCE (no process_exit collected, 4 of 13 event types present on this host), not renderer defects.
CHANGES_PERFORMED: data-glyph on event marks for automation
